title: Monoidal mate compatibility of compact internal adjunction
statement: For a monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category A with functorial flat resolutions and the concrete etale sheaf hypotheses, take compactifiable f:X→S and f-prime:X-prime→S-prime with exceptional right adjoints and invertible compact projection maps. Let TX:D(X,A)→D(X-prime,A) and TY:D(S,A)→D(S-prime,A) be lax monoidal functors, M∈D(X,A), sigma:TY ⋙ Lf-prime-star → Lf-star ⋙ TX, rho:TX ⋙ Rf-prime-! → Rf-! ⋙ TY, and b:Rf-prime-!(TX M)→TY(Rf-!M). Suppose the tensorator of TY followed by tensoring with b and the projection for f equals the vertical composite sigma, the tensorator of TX, rho, and the projection for f-prime. Then applying TY to compact internal adjunction [prop-asd-internal-adjunction], followed by its internal-Hom comparison and precomposition with b, equals the ordinary mate of sigma, the internal-Hom comparison for TX, the image under Rf-prime-star and internal Hom of the exceptional mate of rho, and compact internal adjunction for f-prime, at every Q∈D(S,A). No condition of invertibility on sigma, rho or b is required.

source.place: Final paragraph: compatibility of compact projection, compact exchange, and the ordinary/exceptional adjunction pairings.

proof.text: Write the compact internal-adjunction isomorphisms as conjugates of the projection maps through the composite ordinary, tensor--Hom and exceptional adjunctions. Apply mateEquiv_whiskerTop_conjugateEquiv to the assumed compatibility of projection squares.
Use mateEquiv_hcomp twice to identify the mate of the vertically composed left-adjoint squares with the horizontal composite of the three right-adjoint squares. Evaluate at Q.

The mate of the lax tensorator is ihomComparison. By mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_vcomp, whiskering this tensorator with tensoring by b takes the mate to ihomComparison followed by precomposition with b. Substitute both identifications into the evaluated equality. All arguments are formal adjunction identities and apply unchanged to zero objects and empty schemes.

theorem compactHomMonoidalCompatibility
    (TX : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A) ⥤
      _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology A)) [TX.LaxMonoidal]
    (TY : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A) ⥤
      _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf S'.smallEtaleTopology A)) [TY.LaxMonoidal]
    (M : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A))
    (σ : TwoSquare TY (L(upperStar A f)) (L(upperStar A f')) TX)
    (ρ : TwoSquare TX (rightDerivedLowerShriek A f) (rightDerivedLowerShriek A f') TY)
    (b : (rightDerivedLowerShriek A f').obj (TX.obj M) ⟶
      TY.obj ((rightDerivedLowerShriek A f).obj M))
    (h : ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.μTwoSquare TY ((rightDerivedLowerShriek A f).obj M)).whiskerRight
      ((derivedTensor A S').map b)).whiskerLeft ((projectionMap A f).app M) =
        (σ ≫ᵥ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μTwoSquare TX M ≫ᵥ ρ).whiskerRight
          ((projectionMap A f').app (TX.obj M)))
    (Q : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A)) :
    TY.map ((((derivedHomRightDerivedLowerShriekIso A f).app (op M)).app Q).hom) ≫
      (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ihomComparison TY ((rightDerivedLowerShriek A f).obj M)).app Q ≫
      ((derivedHom A S').map b.op).app (TY.obj Q) =
      (mateEquiv (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction A f)
        (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction A f') σ).app
          (((derivedHom A X).obj (op M)).obj ((rightDerivedUpperShriek A f).obj Q)) ≫
      (R(lowerStar A f')).map
        ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.ihomComparison TX M).app ((rightDerivedUpperShriek A f).obj Q)) ≫
      (R(lowerStar A f')).map (((derivedHom A X').obj (op (TX.obj M))).map
        ((mateEquiv (rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction A f)
          (rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction A f') ρ).app Q)) ≫
      (((derivedHomRightDerivedLowerShriekIso A f').app (op (TX.obj M))).app (TY.obj Q)).hom
